baseline.implementation: current M1-R2 tree with the proof-bound Pass1 subprocess writer

w1.implementation: proof-bound Pass1 generation writer executed in the current deterministic build process

decision.reason: the same-host fixed fixture removed the Pass1 writer subprocess and reduced writer/commit and submit time without changing attempt, commit, response, or trace contracts

limitations: the baseline and W1 each contain one sequential Codex sample, so unrelated open, input, and generation phase noise remains visible
the same-version A/B uses the currently installed desktop Codex 0.151.0-alpha.7.1 because the earlier 0.149 host is no longer installed; it is not compared directly with the older 0.149 timing
the fixture exercises the proof-bound Pass1 whole-window writer only; other stage writers remain subprocess-backed and were not changed
the timing covers MCP server and outer tool-call intervals, not end-to-end model inference or total token cost
